usedFor: siteleaf starts with “New Page Is Created”, and LeadConnector receives it through “Add or Remove Contact from Workflow”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Page Is Created” in siteleaf, then “Add or Remove Contact from Workflow” in LeadConnector
bestTemplate.why: The action adds or removes a contact by Contact ID, Email or Phone number.

watchOut: Every siteleaf trigger here is polling, so “New Page Is Created” reaches LeadConnector on a schedule.
